title: Employee
description: Employee record with personal information, department, position, hire date, salary, manager relationship, and employment status. Used for HR systems, payroll, and organizational management.

employee_id.description: Unique employee ID or badge number

department.description: Department where the employee works (e.g., Engineering, Sales, HR)

position.description: Job title or position (e.g., Software Engineer, Sales Manager)

hire_date.description: Date when the employee was hired

salary.description: Annual salary in the company's currency

manager_id.description: Foreign key reference to the employee's manager

status.description: Employment status (e.g., active, on_leave, terminated, retired)
